selected_scope.title: LC Office V81 Integration
selected_scope.finding: S1.42AJ remains the balanced lifecycle candidate and is not accepted. Its full-normal Offense evidence proves LC Office viability at author rarity 65 and final normalized effective rarity 100. DIAG1 force-selected and generated LC Office but produced a user-reported later-day stutter of roughly 3-4 hitches per second. Exact DIAG2 changes only Piggy.LCOffice [General] Camera Frame Speed to 0 versus DIAG1. The first DIAG2 Offense runtime evidence is ingested at RuntimeEvidence/S1.42AJ-DIAG2/20260918T144306Z/ with log SHA-256 9147a9f46ad96788f245b839f6d08b53454fbf3e1ad87bfb76d3f060f70ed5ac. LC Office generated, entrance/traversal and elevator operation were evidenced, and 15 scrap values were generated, matching the DIAG1 total. Interior vents spawned Bunker Spider, Masked, Spring, two Immortal Snails and Jester shortly before player death. The user reported no noticeable stutter before dying but did not visually observe an interior enemy. Because the run ended about 6m17 after Office generation, earlier than DIAG1's roughly 7m39 post-generation span, the result supports but does not causally confirm the camera-render hypothesis. A longer exact-DIAG2 confirmation run remains required.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Repeat exact published S1.42AJ-DIAG2 on Offense with no rebuild or additional delta. Preserve Camera Frame Speed = 0 and DIAG1 force-selection. Continue substantially into the later in-game day, specifically determine whether the DIAG1-style repeated stutter remains absent, and visually observe at least one spawned interior enemy long enough to validate ordinary movement/pathfinding/interaction. Reconfirm Office generation/traversal/elevator and keep scrap behavior under observation. Preserve balanced S1.42AJ unchanged and do not promote or reject it from this diagnostic alone. If the camera hypothesis is confirmed, derive any balanced successor from exact S1.42AJ, never from DIAG1/DIAG2. Universal-moon availability and unrelated Interior scopes remain out of scope.
selected_scope.next_action: Run a longer confirmation pass with the exact already-published S1.42AJ-DIAG2 on Offense. Reach the later-day window where DIAG1 previously showed frequent stutter, report whether that stutter remains absent, and visually observe at least one interior enemy after spawn to confirm ordinary behavior. Reconfirm LC Office traversal/elevator and observe scrap generation, then upload the resulting LogOutput.log again as S1.42AJ-DIAG2 evidence. No rebuild or additional config change is required.
